The backends of `+ciphers::chacha20_poly1305+`, from the test programs that run it:

[cols="1,2,2,4",options="header"]
|===
|Backend |Jamfile |Header |Targets

|BearSSL
|`+/third_party//bearssl+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/bearssl.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten (tested by `+chacha_bearssl+`, `+chacha_wycheproof_bearssl+`, `+allocation_bearssl+`, `+agreement_chacha+`, `+agreement_chacha_emscripten+`, `+agreement_chacha_portable+`, `+agreement_chacha_portable_emscripten+`)

|OpenSSL
|`+/webcpp/crypto//openssl+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/openssl.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3 (tested by `+chacha_openssl+`, `+chacha_wycheproof_openssl+`, `+allocation_openssl+`, `+openssl_error_queue+`, `+agreement_chacha+`, `+agreement_chacha_portable+`); not on emscripten: `+/webcpp/crypto//openssl+` stops the build there

|ctaes
|`+/third_party//ctaes+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/ctaes.hpp>+`
|refused at compile time (`+chacha_on_ctaes+`)

|libsodium
|`+/third_party//sodium+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/sodium.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten (tested by `+chacha_sodium+`, `+chacha_wycheproof_sodium+`, `+allocation_sodium+`, `+agreement_chacha+`, `+agreement_chacha_emscripten+`)
|===

`+chacha20_poly1305<>+` names the default backend. The default per target, whatever the program links, as <<crypto-backends-defaults>> gives it with its reasons and tests:

[cols="1,1",options="header"]
|===
|Target |Default

|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
|libsodium
|===
